Vanilla 26.3 fixtures, frozen server worlds from:
  mise run worldgen:parity -- -seed 0 -from -24,-24 -to 23,23
  mise run worldgen:parity -- -seed 12345 -from -24,-24 -to 23,23

The small_structures_<seed>_<chunkX>_<chunkZ>.nbt files retain the start
compound from structures.starts, the unopened block_entities inside its
children's saved bounding boxes, and the structure blocks in those boxes.
Blocks record the resolved block state ID and block name. The sampled kinds
are the parity tool's "structure block" category plus stairs, slabs,
trapdoors and fences. They are copied from vanilla's saved section palettes,
not computed by the Go world generator.

seed   chunk    structure          template
0      0,-22    buried_treasure
0      15,-22   buried_treasure
0      14,8     shipwreck_beached  sideways_full
12345  -8,2     shipwreck          sideways_fronthalf_degraded
12345  11,10    shipwreck          sideways_fronthalf_degraded
